character: Largest downhill in the Jura (40km). Cross-country paradise (100km+). On the Swiss border. Mont d'Or summit (1,463m). Family-friendly, forested, peaceful. Geneva 50 min.

non_ski_activities.downhill: 40km downhill — largest in Jura. Mont d'Or summit 1,463m.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowshoeing, sledging, winter hiking. Swiss border proximity. Lac de Saint-Point nearby.
